༄༅/ /khro chu dug gdong nag po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bca' gzhi lag len gyi shog dril bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// khro chu dug gdong nag po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bca' gzhi lag len gyi shog dril bsdus pa bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dpal ya mānta ka la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir 'jam dpal las kyi gshin rje rigs gsum 'dus pa khro chu dug gdong sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ 'di nyid dkyil 'khor dang slob dpon nus ldan las dbang lung legs par thob cing gzhung dang man ngag gi mtha' rgya chod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ sgrub pa'i thabs ni gsum ste/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las la sbyor ba'o// dang po bsnyen pa la/ dur khrod la sogs pa drag po mngon spyod kyi las su shis pa'i gnas rnams su/ gza' skar 'grub sbyor ram/ bdud rgyal gang rung dang ldan pa'i dus su/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ mi nag /rta nag /bya nag /g.yag nag /ra nag /stag gzig la sogs pa'i sha khrag dang*/ btsan dug thang khrom la sogs pa'i dug sna dang*/ 'bru sna tshogs tshad chang dang bsres pa sems can gyi gson khrag gis sbrus pa'i gtor ma zur gsum phur bu'i dbal lta bu chung ba drug dang*/ gtso bo las chung ba sde drug las cung zad che ba gcig yum gyi gtor ma ste/ de ltar na 'khor che chung bdun gyis bskor ba la drag po rtsang gi rgyan dang ldan zhing*/ sha khrag gis sbags la gtor gdugs dang mda' dar gyis spras te/ gtor snod ni lcags sam thod pa la bya'o// gzhan yang bris sku dang rten rdzas la sogs pa'ang bkram/ lcags sam bhandha'i snod cig tu las gshin gyi gtor ma sha khrag dang rtsang gis brgyan pa'ang bsham/ rtags gtor dang 'dzin gtor gyi rgyu'ang bshad ma thag pa ltar bya'o// de ltar bkod legs par bgyis pa'i mdun du pañtsa a mṛ tas sbags pa'i chang zhim po'i sman mchod dang*/ mi'i khrag gam dud 'gro'i gson khrag la sogs dug sna dang khrag chen gyis sbags pa'i rakta dang*/ las byang gi mchod pa byin rlabs nas bshad pa lta bu'i ru spos kyis sbags pa'i mchod pa rnams bsham mo// yang sman gdong dug gi byin rlabs kyi dbang gtor ni/

zan gru gsum ngos mdun du bstan pa'i ro gdan mgo mdun du phyogs pa'i steng du gtor ma zur gsum pa'i ngos mdun du bstan pa rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa 'khor med pa bya/ dbang gtor ma gtogs bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi gtor ma thams cad zur mdun du bstan/ de ltar gong du bshad pa bshams zin nas/ sgrub pa po mtshams dam par bya/ gtor ma cha gsum ltar byin la bar chad mi 'byung zhing bsam don 'grub pa'i bka' bsgo/ las byang gzhung bsrang zhing sa mā dhi'i dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang nas/ rtsa sngags la srung zlog bsad pa'i sham bu ma btags pa kho na ngag bcad la bzla/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu bcad pa'i/ nyi shar/ nyin gung*| nyi nub/ nam srod/ nam gung*/ tho rangs te thun drug la gtor ma mtheb skyu dang sha dang sman raka gis gsos la/ gtor bsngos dang bstod pa gang rung bya/ nangs zhogs lag yig mi mthong ba'i dus tsam nas gshin rje tshe bdag gi mngon rtogs bsgom zhing de'i mjug tu khro chu'i las byang gzhung bsrang*/ nyin gung gi thun tsam la rtsa sngags mjug tu yum sngags btags pa sum brgya re tsam bzla/ dgong thun thog ma la tshogs mchod bya zhing mnga' gsol dang bskang ba bya/ srod thun gyi dus thun gtor las gshin gyi bskul gyis khang steng du 'bul/ rnam g.yeng dang rgyud dal spangs la/ rab dngos/ 'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam du lha 'grub pa'i mtshan ma brtan po ma mthong gi bar du bsgrub/ de'i ring la dam nyams dang yug grib sogs mi gtsang ba mtha' dag la 'dzem/ bud med sogs dang nyal po spang*/ mdor na lha sgrub pa'i gegs mtha' dag spangs la bsgrub par bya'o// de ltar bsgrubs nas grub pa'i mtshan ma mthong ma thag rtags gtor 'bul zhing rten gtor sgul bskyod med par sgrub khang phugs su bzhugs su gsol/ 'dzin gtor 'phral du gso zhing gtor bsngos dang mngal gsol bskang ba ma chag par bya/ khyad par dgu gsum/

'bring gis dgu gnyis sam tshes bcu dang nyer dgu /tha mas nyer dgu la mnga' gsol bskang ba sogs ma chag par bya/ 'phral la lha'i bskyed rim dang bsnyen pa ma chag par bya ba sogs lha sgrub gzhan ltar bya zhing*/ lha dang bla ma la the tshom spangs pa'i yid ches par bya zhing rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig ma nyams par dus dang yun du bya ba gal che'o// gnyis pa de ltar bsnyen pas lha'i rtags mthong ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ sgrub pa la 'jug pa la'ang gsum/ srung ba/ zlog pa/ bsad pa'o// dang po srung ba ni/ bca' gzhi snga ma lta bu la/ rtsa sngags la srung sngags btags pa bzla zhing*/ srung dmigs sa mā dhi dgu skor la gnad du bsnun/ gtor ma'i rgyu sogs bsnyen dus ltar la de las che ba bya/ gtso bo la chu srin gyi zhal rngam 'don pa sogs mthong rgyud ltar bya/ srod thun ma gtogs pa lnga por thun gtor re re gnod byed kyi sha khrag tu dmigs la 'bul zhing bstod bskul yang srung ba'i sham bu yang zlog me'i spu gri ltar btags shing phrin las bcol/ srod thun gyi dus thun gtor las gshin bskul gyis phyir 'phang*/ gzhan thams cad bsnyen dus ltar bya/ dmigs pa ni sa mā dhi dgu skor nyid yin no// gzhan srung ba'i lag len rnams ni yang zlog ltar bya zhing*/ srung rtags gshin rje'i bya lam nas bshad pa ltar byung na mtshams grol/ sgrub khang thog tu gser skyems phul nas gtor chen bskul ring bas bskul/ dgug gzhug gsum sogs bya zhing*/ gtor bsngos kyi mjug tu srung ba'i phrin las bcol/ slar bskul thung gis phyir spags las gshin bskul gyis gtor ma rnams thebs dang bstun nas rgyag /gtor mnan sogs las gzhung ltar byas pas grub bo// gnyis pa zlog pa'i man ngag ni/ g.yul bkyes pa'i sa la sogs pa bkra mi shis pa'i sa sna tshogs la stegs bu rgyar mda' gang*/ dpangs su khru gang ba'i dbus su brub khung gri lcags sam gong gi sa las byas pa kha khyer bang rim gsum ldan/

che chung 'tsham pa'i nang gri khrag la sogs dug sna khrag sna bsres pas dmar po dang*/ phyi ro sol gyis nag por byugs pa'i kha khyer la drag po'i rtsang phur dug khrag dang gri khrag /ro sol gyis sbags pa nyer brgyad srin mo'i 'gros su btsug /rtse mo sha ling zan dum mgo mjug ldog pas brgyan dgos par bshad/ stegs bu'i mthar yang bshad ma thag pa lta bu'i rtsang brgyad cu btsugs pa'i rtse rnams su dgra bo'i ling chung sha dum bskyon/ bka' bzhi rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin zhing*/ kha cig ma traṃ gi lto bar chos 'byung gi dbus su bshams pa ni zor gdan dang bca' gzhi nor bas shin tu nongs so// de nas bshad ma thag pa'i brub khung dgra'i bgegs la byed na rang la gang gnod kyi lha 'dre de gnas sa'i sa rdo shing chu sogs liṅgar bsres ming yang de bzhin du bsgyur ba sogs zhal las shes so// dri ma drug gang rung dang bsres pa'i bag zan gyi liṅga'i snying gar byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i ming rus dug khrag gis bris pa bcug /liṅga de la'ang dug khrag gis byugs la gan rkyal du brub khung du mgo rang la bstan nas bzhag /de'i steng du khri'u 'am mañdzi'i khar sngar srung ba'i dus bshad pa lta bu'i gtor chen bris skus brgyan pa bsham/ las gshin la'ang sngar bshad pa ltar gtor ma gcig bsham/ stegs bu'i steng gi rtsang gi nang skor du/ spom nag /skyer pa/ ro bsregs pa'i shing ste gdug pa can gyi shing de gsum ste/ 'ug pa/ bya rog /srin bya ste ltas ngan bya gsum gyi sgro bsgron pa'i mda' la gri lcags kyi mde'u sprad pa/ dug khrag gis sbags pa'i mda' de la mtshams su zlog pa'i sngags byang bris pa/ mchog chen gyi gzhu dang bcas pa'i mda' zor dang*/ ri gsum 'dus pa'i sa dang*/ g.yul bkyes pa'i sa dang*| dur khrod kyi sa la sogs pa bkra mi shis pa'i sa sna tshogs las drag po'i kong bu zur gsum pa dpangs mtho gang rgyar ngos rer sor bcu pa rnams gri khrag dang mtshal byugs pa/

phyi ro sol dang nang dug khrag byugs pa'i nang du thun sna tshogs yungs dkar nag /dur rdo/ gri lcags/ thun rdzas sna tshogs thun sngags dang zlog bsad sngags kyis gzir nas/ blugs pa rtsang gis brgyan pa/ yang sa de nyid las byas pa'i khrag zor zur gsum dpangs su sor bzhi rgyar sor drug phyi ro sol dang dug khrag /nang gri khrag dang mtshal gyis byugs pa'i nang du/ khrag sna tshogs tshad blugs pa rtsang gis brgyan pa'i khrag zor dang*/ lcags sam bhandhar nas/ gro/ sran ma/ so ba/ 'bras te/ 'bru sna tshogs ngar phye byas pa/ dug khrag gis sbrus pa'i zur gsum mtho gang pa dug khrag gis sbags pa rgyan med mda' mdung mtshe yungs rtsang gis brgyan pa'i gtor zor te/ de lta bu'i zor rnams zor rdzas thams cad la dug shog la dug khrag gis rtsa sngags dang*| sde brgyad kyi sngags sham du zlog bsad gang yin gyi sham bu them bcas bris pa re re dkri zhing*/ gzhan rnams kyi nang du'ang gzhug go// rab phyogs mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis dang bcur 'phen pa'i dbang gis zor bzhi po bcu bcu dang*/ de ma 'byor na'ang phyogs bzhir 'phen pa'i dbang gis bzhi bzhi dang thams cad la zlog sngags bris pas brgyan cing*/ zlog bsad kyi sngags kyis ngar blud pa dag phyogs rnams su spel nas zor bskul ltar snga phyi ma log par bshams/ de dag gi mdun du 'debs kha'i gtor ma lha grangs dang mnyam pa sha khrag gis sbags pa dang*/ mthar mchod pa dang thun gtor sogs gong ltar bsham/ gdab las 'phral la bya rgyu lcags sam bhandhar dgra'i dri ma bsres pa'i zan ling nang du dgra'i ming rus bris pa bcug cing dug khrag gis sbags la gtor chung*/ chang bu/ skyu gu dang bcas pa dang*/ gzhan yang phur bu/ thun mtshon cha la sogs pa gdab las la mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bsham/ de nas las byang sogs sngar bshad pa ltar las/ tshogs mchod gung thun la bya/

rtsang gyer/ zlog gzhung la sogs pa smad las thams cad dgong thun dang srod thun la bya/ dus drug tu thun gtor las gshin gyis bskul bas gang gnod pa'i dgra phyogs su 'phang zhing bskul gyi sngon du dgug gzhug gsum re dang gtor bsngos bya zhing*/ zlog pa'i 'dod gsol bya/ zlog pa'i dmigs pa ri rab khong nyul ltar las byang du bris yod pas de ltar bsgom zhing rtsa sngags mjug tu zlog pa'i sham bu btags la bzla zhing*/ zlog pa'i rtags gshin rje'i bya lam srung thabs nas bshad pa ltar mthong nas/ brub khung nas liṅga tshur bton/ gdab las byas la 'bul/ sgrub khang thog tu gser skyems mjug la zor rnams rang rang bskul gyis phyogs su 'phang*/ gtor chen bskul ba sogs srung ba'i dus ltar bya/ de ltar zlog pa'i yan lag 'di'ang srung ba'i mthar sbrel na 'thad cing*/ de ltar byed na bca' gzhi 'di srung ba'i gong nas bya dgos so// zhes pa 'di'ang 'bri gung pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i ljags bsgrigs so/// /sarba maṅga laṃ//
